changes: Apple Events usage declaration in English/Italian and app-only automation entitlement.
MCP calls have no fixed 30-second lifetime; optional total deadline, bounded observations, session-owned status/wait/cancel.
Stop discards delivery into later turns while preserving action records; cancellation is best effort, without automatic replay.
Manual MCP invocation shares lifecycle; premature final answers wait for the real result.

limits: Tests use local synthetic MCP/HTTP fixtures and isolated archives. No REA/Hopper/Ghidra tool invocation, user-chat modification, permission reset or installed-app replacement.

Apple TCC consent and external-process signing remain independent. The app declaration cannot fix missing entitlements in Hopper itself; Ghidra still needs its provider environment and a supported binary architecture.
Cancellation is best effort and cannot undo effects already performed by a server. No automatic retry; jobs are runtime-only.
No installed-app GUI end-to-end or live-LLM MCP autonomy qualification; native M1 and Intel core lifecycle and Universal compilation are the verified scope.
Reference historical UI/remote-thinking tests remain in RELEASE_1.4.9.03_QA.json; no new GPU/performance/KL claims.
